subject: info-trns
title: INFO.TRNS.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in WM-26, the page where Braxton declares that 'the progressional actualness of a given creative manifestation transcends the particulars of any one empirical criterion, and as such the whole subject of musicology has to be dealt with very delicately.' INFO-TRNS (information transference) is *crossed* — (c) prefix — with SOC-RT (social reality), the central claim being that what gets transmitted as 'information' about world creativity is structurally entangled with the social-reality position of the transmitting culture. Five branches radiate from INFO-TRNS: into EXT-FT (extended functionalism), with a dashed link to RT-OP (reality options) → SOC-RT, registering the conditional nature of how western functionalist transmission constrains what reality-options reach social reality; into MT-DI (multi-dimensional/ism) with a dashed link to MTH (methodology); into TR (transformation) → CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis, dashed) → PRI-AF-TO (primary affinity tendencies); into POL-DYM (political dynamics); into SPT-AW (spiritual awareness) with a dashed link to CN-INFO (controlled information); and into A-PR (all-purpose). The dashed conventions cluster around exactly the relations Braxton identifies as distorted by western misdocumentation: information transference is being mediated, not direct.
